userStories.title: Fix live search with real debounced API call and suggestions fallback when empty
userStories.description: The current `fetchSkills()` in `src/panels/MarketplacePanel.tsx` (lines 144–160) hardcodes `query: 'skill'` in the POST body and then filters the 20 results client-side at lines 167–172. This means any query not contained in those 20 titles/descriptions returns nothing. Replace the entire fetch + client-side filter approach with a debounced live search that calls `POST /api/skills/search` with the actual user query. When `searchQuery` is empty, display workspace-aware suggestions from `GET /api/skills/suggestions?workspaceId={workspaceId}` instead of a blank/error state.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the `fetchSkills` callback and its `useEffect` at lines 144–164.
Remove the `filteredSkills` useMemo/filter at lines 167–172.
Add a `useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>` named `debounceRef` for the debounce timer.
Add a new `useEffect` that watches `[searchQuery, activeTab, activeSource, workspaceId]`. When `activeTab !== 'skills'` or `activeSource !== 'skills.sh'`, return early without fetching.

Inside the effect: clear `debounceRef.current` on each run. If `searchQuery.trim()` is non-empty, set a 300ms timeout that calls `POST /api/skills/search` with body `{ query: searchQuery.trim(), limit: 20 }`. On success, call `setSkills(data.results)` and set `setError(null)`. On failure, call `setError(err.message)`.

If `searchQuery.trim()` is empty (no search query active), immediately (no debounce) call `GET /api/skills/suggestions?workspaceId={workspaceId}` and map the response into the `SkillResult[]` shape: `{ name: suggestion.skill, description: suggestion.triggeredBy.join(', '), author: '', url: '' }`. Set loading states appropriately during this fetch.
The `GET /api/skills/suggestions` response shape is `{ suggestions: [{ skill: string, triggeredBy: string[], installed: boolean }] }`. Extract `data.suggestions` and map as described.
While either fetch is in flight, set `setLoading(true)`. Set `setLoading(false)` in the finally block.
Add a `useEffect` cleanup that calls `clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)` on unmount.
The search input `onChange` at line 269 must only call `setSearchQuery(e.target.value)` — the effect drives the fetch; do not call any fetch function directly in `onChange`.
The empty state text at line 331–335 must change to: if `searchQuery` is non-empty, show `No skills matching "{searchQuery}"`; if empty, show `No suggestions found for this workspace`.
The Discovery Results heading must update its count to reflect `skills.length` (no separate `filteredSkills` array).
All skill cards in the grid must render from the `skills` state directly.
On tab change away from `skills` or source change away from `skills.sh`, reset `skills` to `[]` and `error` to `null`.

userStories.title: Implement GitHub Repos and Custom source tabs with correct per-source UI in the left discovery panel
userStories.description: The `activeSource` state (line 82) is set correctly when clicking the three source pills (skills.sh, GitHub Repos, Custom), but the left panel (lines 303–422) only ever renders the skills.sh result grid — it ignores `activeSource` entirely. When `activeSource === 'github'`, show a GitHub repo URL input + Browse button that calls `POST /api/skills/browse-github`. When `activeSource === 'custom'`, show a paste textarea + Install button that calls `POST /api/skills/install`. The search bar and source pills only apply when `activeTab === 'skills'`.
acceptanceCriteria: Add two new interfaces: `GitHubSkillResult` with fields `{ name: string; description: string; path: string; installed: boolean }` and `GitHubBrowseResponse` with fields `{ repo: string; branch: string; skills: GitHubSkillResult[] }`.
Add state: `githubRepoUrl: string` (default `''`), `githubSkills: GitHubSkillResult[]` (default `[]`), `githubLoading: boolean` (default `false`), `githubError: string | null` (default `null`).
Add state: `customContent: string` (default `''`), `customName: string` (default `''`), `customInstalling: boolean` (default `false`).

Add `handleBrowseGitHub` async function: set loading true, POST to `/api/skills/browse-github` with body `{ repoUrl: githubRepoUrl }`, on success call `setGithubSkills(data.skills)`, on error set `githubError`, always set loading false.

Add `handleInstallFromGitHub(skill: GitHubSkillResult)` async: set install state 'installing', POST `/api/skills/install-from-github` with `{ repoUrl: githubRepoUrl, skillPath: skill.path, workspaceId }`, on success set 'done' + toast + `fetchInstalled()`, on error set 'error' + toast.

Add `handleInstallCustom` async: POST `/api/skills/install` with `{ name: customName.trim(), content: customContent.trim(), source: 'user' }`, on success toast + reset fields + `fetchInstalled()`, set `customInstalling` around the call.
In the left panel `<div className="w-[60%] ...">`, the existing skills.sh grid must be wrapped inside `activeSource === 'skills.sh'` within the `activeTab === 'skills'` check.

When `activeTab === 'skills'` and `activeSource === 'github'`: render a heading 'Browse GitHub Repository', a flex row with text input (placeholder: 'https://github.com/owner/repo' or 'owner/repo', bound to `githubRepoUrl`, Enter key triggers browse) + Browse button (calls `handleBrowseGitHub`, disabled while `githubLoading`, shows spinner while loading). If `githubError`, render red alert. If `githubSkills.length > 0`, render a skill card list showing name, description, path, and Install/Installed button.

When `activeTab === 'skills'` and `activeSource === 'custom'`: render heading 'Install Custom Skill', text input for `customName` (placeholder: 'my-skill'), textarea for `customContent` (rows: 10, placeholder: 'Paste your SKILL.md content here...'), Install button (disabled if name/content empty or installing, shows spinner while installing).
Wrap search bar and source pills in `{activeTab === 'skills' && (...)}` so they only show for the skills tab.
Add `useEffect` on `[activeSource]` to reset `githubSkills`, `githubError` when switching to github, and `customContent`, `customName` when switching to custom.

userStories.title: Add expand toggle with content preview to discovery cards and library cards
userStories.description: Neither the left panel (discovery) skill cards (lines 341–399) nor the right panel (library) skill cards (lines 470–505) have any way to preview skill content. Add a chevron expand/collapse toggle to each card. When expanded: installed skills fetch from `GET /api/skills/{name}/content`; uninstalled discovery cards fetch from `GET /api/skills/preview?query={name}`. Display the markdown content in a scrollable pre block with word count and estimated token count.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `previewCache` state: `Record<string, { content: string; wordCount: number; estimatedTokens: number } | 'loading' | 'error'>` initialized to `{}`.

Add `fetchPreview(name: string, installed: boolean): void` function. If `previewCache[name]` already exists, return early. Set `previewCache[name] = 'loading'`. If installed, call `GET /api/skills/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/content${workspaceId ? '?workspaceId=' + workspaceId : ''}`. If not installed, call `GET /api/skills/preview?query=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`. On success set the cache entry to `{ content, wordCount, estimatedTokens }`. On error set `'error'`. Use functional updater `setPreviewCache(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }))`.
Add `expandedCards` state: `Set<string>` initialized to `new Set()`.

Add `toggleCard(name: string)` function: toggle presence of `name` in `expandedCards` (create new Set). If expanding and `previewCache[name]` is undefined, call `fetchPreview(name, isInstalled(name))`.
Import `ChevronDown` and `ChevronRight` from `lucide-react`.

In left panel discovery cards: add a chevron button (bottom right of card, `text-muted hover:text-text`, calls `toggleCard(skill.name)`). When `expandedCards.has(skill.name)`, render content preview below — spinner if loading, error text if error, otherwise `{wordCount} words · ~{estimatedTokens} tokens` + `<pre className="text-[10px] text-muted whitespace-pre-wrap break-words max-h-48 overflow-y-auto font-mono bg-panel/50 p-2 rounded mt-1">` with content.
In right panel library cards: same chevron pattern. Installed skills always use the content endpoint (`fetchPreview(skill.name, true)`).
Add `useEffect` on `[activeTab]` that resets `expandedCards` to `new Set()`. `previewCache` persists across tab changes.
`GET /api/skills/preview` returns `{ name, content, description, source, skillId, wordCount, estimatedTokens }`. Use `data.wordCount` and `data.estimatedTokens` directly.
`GET /api/skills/{name}/content` returns `{ name, content, description, wordCount, estimatedTokens }`. Use `data.wordCount` and `data.estimatedTokens` directly.
Click on the chevron button must not propagate to any parent click handlers (use `e.stopPropagation()` where needed).
